description: Verified RELEASED fills for shelf games that currently have no date in the RELEASED map in index.html. Each Gameye date was checked against Wikidata and/or Wikipedia North American (or worldwide, when the launch was worldwide) release dates. Do not overwrite dates already in RELEASED. Store each fill under released_key (sitedata nkey + '|' + system) as [month, day, year], the same shape the site already uses: day 0 means month and year only, and [0, 0, year] means year only (released_text() must be extended for that last case). Later fills may use a verified Wikipedia, MobyGames, GameFAQs, or official-list date for the owned console and region even when that date disagrees with Gameye. Dates are still never guessed, and dates already in RELEASED are never overwritten.
